coordinateSystem: Design X right/Y up/Z back; body anchor origin at collar Y=24; 1 unit=1/16 block

keyPoseBudget.nativeSamples: 50fps bake, pose parameters shared across five profiles/two arm widths

curve: offset weight (1-t)^3; zero final velocity; no size animation
scope: A short secondary settle AFTER ownership changes: stow on the back, draw at the hand. No continuous physical hand-to-back travel is proposed.
identity: One visual item per recorded actual reference; never infer from name/model appearance
handoff: Switch visual owner immediately from current authoritative state; suppress the old owner in the same frame before applying the local settle.
firstPerson: Keep native first-person item equip animation; no own-back drawing or cross-screen flight

interruptions.rapidSwitch: Discard old settle. Re-evaluate latest eligible reference and current owner; begin only the new current settle.
interruptions.attackUseBowBlock: Stop any draw settle and use native hand pose immediately; do not delay attack/use/block.
interruptions.gliderOrClimb: Existing gameplay pose takes priority. Eligible back settle may continue body-local; no extra reaching arm.
interruptions.dropBreakInventoryIdentityLoss: Remove visual item immediately, no outgoing ghost.
interruptions.capeElytraInvisibilitySpectator: Apply existing visibility policy before evaluating any settle; hidden item stays hidden.
interruptions.pauseDisconnectRespawnDimension: Clear local animation state; do not replay old settles on resume/load.
interruptions.crouchSwimTurn: Derive body/hand endpoints from live pose each render frame; these standing guides are not frozen world-space targets.
interruptions.reducedMotion: Animation can be disabled and still resolve the same owner/scale/visibility immediately; setting integration separate.

preserveNativeAppearance: Use sanitized native ItemStackRenderState, preserve shield patterns/dye/damage/glint and supported models; preview uses adopted A09 geometry references only

scenes.heldEndpointScope: Pose-guide only. Integration must use live native third-person hand transform.
